## 3. Optional C23 Annex K profile

Annex K is optional in C23 and **Excluded** from this library's core
claim. No safe module exports any `_s` symbol; symbol-absence is pinned
by `test/compile_fail/c23_annex_k_absent.sv0` (C23K-001).

## 5. POSIX.1-2024 Issue 8 `<string.h>` / `<strings.h>` matrix

Classified by feature profile (SPEC POSIX-013). Completeness against the
full Issue 8 inventory and the one-classification-per-symbol rule are
machine-checked by `tools/check_posix_matrix.py` (SPEC POSIX-001 /
AC-017). ISO C `<string.h>` functions that POSIX also mandates are
carried by their C23 rows in section 2 and are not repeated here.

### 5.0 Required declarations (POSIX-016)

| declaration | header | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `NULL` | `<string.h>` | Adapted |
| `locale_t` | `<string.h>` | Host-dependent |
| `size_t` | `<string.h>` | Adapted |

Safe-façade mapping: `size_t` -> `usize`, `NULL` -> `Option::None` / absence, `locale_t` -> `strings_locale::LocaleId` + the capability lifecycle (`docs/locale-capability.md`, `docs/posix-header-surface.md`).
